**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/183_P32.22__bounded-recovery-and-activation.md live_verification=false` ·

## What this does

P32.6 (ADR-125) shipped `evidence-audit/1` + `recovery-plan/1` — a read-only
audit and a deliberately **dry-run-only** planner keyed by deterministic
`action_digest`s. This ticket lands the **authorized application half** the
chain requires: execute an explicitly bounded selected scope of those
proposals, rematerialize the read surface in dependency order, and freeze an
unpublished repaired-input snapshot + audit preview — the **HUMAN-H4** frame.
`live_verification=false`: every claim below is proven on a throwaway
PG18+PostGIS spine seeded deterministically from the committed P32.6 fixture.
Nothing hosted, public, gated, or human ran; `D-R10-LIVE-1` stays **OPEN**;
the final post-evaluation release candidate is **P32.23a**'s, not this stage's.

### `recovery_apply` (sqitch) — the exactly-once barrier + least privilege

- **`recovery_application`** — one append-only row per executed action;
  `UNIQUE(action_digest)` is the resume marker (the `intake.application`
  shape). Every action runs advisory-locked in ONE transaction — marker
  check → provenance re-verify → canonical write → receipt commit,
  atomically. A mid-batch crash reconciles `already_applied`; feeding
  recorded digests back into `recovery-plan` proposes **+0**.
- **`sig_recovery`** (NOLOGIN NOBYPASSRLS) — exactly the §16.6 repair
  surface: INSERT on `claim`, `claim_evidence`, `recovery_application`,
  `publication_disposition`, `ingest_run`, guarded adjudicator-entity mint;
  `UPDATE (sys_period)` on `claim` — the only update append-only permits;
  `sig_read_sealed` membership for FORCED claim RLS; validation SELECTs.
  **No** capture/extraction/blob/source writes, no DELETE, no review
  decisions — there is no privilege path to a refetch, and no code path
  either (the module contains zero fetch/transport code).

### `db.recovery_apply.PgRecoveryApplier` — per-action atomic apply

- `record_disposition` → `db.dispositions.record_disposition` under the
  shared `policy.eligibility.new_disposition` validator — the plan's
  placeholder authority is replaced by the recorded **operator
  authorization**; the audit basis survives in `rationale`.
- `bind_verified_capture` → re-verifies the capture row + pinned
  object/version + digest, then `INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` —
  an existing immutable PK records an honest `conflict_existing` outcome
  with the typedness finding, never a fabricated row, never an UPDATE.
- `repair_claim` → the §16.6 correction pair: close the prior open
  `sys_period` (a concurrent close → `stale_record`, never double-close),
  INSERT the corrected claim (`revises_claim` + `correction_reason` +
  adjudicator `asserted_by` minted via `resolve_identities`), re-bind the
  same captures. `revised_fields` is a fail-closed allowlist (`value_geom`
  out of scope); every revised string passes the Part VIII refusal screen.
- Malformed `proposed_row` → `RecoveryApplyError` (fail-closed), never a
  bare `KeyError`/`ValueError` escaping the failure capture.

### `ops.recovery_apply` — bounded orchestration + freeze

- **Scope reconciliation, fail closed** — plan must be `recovery-plan/1`
  over the same audit population digest, `exceeds_ceiling` false, every
  selected action `proposed`; batch/kind/claim selectors +
  `max_actions` abort threshold; deterministic digest order; one worker.
- **Ceilings re-checked before a write** — the S1 §6 batch bounds
  (10 000 assertions / 250 MiB distinct bytes / 1 worker) + storage
  headroom rules are recorded and enforced.
- **Bind re-verification only** — the probe re-reads the pinned
  occurrence; `None`/`False` is an explicit `skipped` result. The
  +0 rerun re-applies the SAME gate so a skipped bind is skipped again,
  never snuck in through the rerun path.
- **Recorded accounting** — before/after scoped inventories, inventory
  delta, per-kind `result_writes`, receipts, reverified bytes,
  wall clock, `verify_rerun` `plus_zero` proof.
- **`run_rematerialize`** — the six shared materializers in the recorded
  dependency order (resolution → camera-sites → edges → contradictions →
  coverage → accountability), each its own transaction, counts + timing
  recorded, append-only + +0 on unchanged input.
- **`freeze_snapshot`** → `sig.repaired-snapshot/1` —
  `frozen_unpublished` + `provisional_preview` + `not_a_release_candidate`,
  pinning code/schema/semantic-rules identities, applied-write digests,
  the population frame (pre/post digests, eligible set, watermarks) and
  the post-apply audit digest + findings; `AUDIT_PREVIEW.md` is the
  human-readable preview for HUMAN-H4.
- **`PROVISIONAL_VS_SHADOW`** — the provisional production rules stay
  active while `eval-confidence/1` remains `shadow` with `applied: []`;
  activation refusals are enumerated; no safety demotion is scoped in
  this stage.
- **`recovery-apply-return-pass/1`** — the prepared, unexecuted
  operator-gated live packet (commands, pins, ceilings, checklist,
  explicit reservations) — the OPEN return-pass row for `D-R10-LIVE-1`.

### CLI (additive, ops/AGENTS rules)

- `sig-ops recovery-apply` — dry-run reconcile by default (zero writes);
  `--apply` requires `--execution-id` + `--authority`.
- `sig-ops recovery-freeze` — the unpublished snapshot + preview.
- `sig-ops recovery-fixture-seed` — seeds a deployed TEST spine from the
  committed P32.6 fixture packet (deterministic uuid5 id map; idempotent;
  synthetic rows carry no byte reference, preserving the audit's
  synthetic/no-byte semantics).
- `evidence-audit` / `recovery-plan` are unchanged — still dry-run-only.

### Fixture proof (the committed packet under `docs/build/reports/p32.22-bounded-recovery/`)

On a throwaway PG18+PostGIS spine (full sqitch deploy incl. `recovery_apply`):

- 16 fixture claims seeded; audit reproduces the 8/14 = 57.1% trio.
- Plan: 19 actions, **4 proposed** (3 `record_disposition` + 1 `repair_claim`).
- Apply: **4 applied / 0 skipped / 0 failed**; `verify_rerun`:
  `plus_zero: true` (all `already_applied`, zero inventory delta).
- Writes: 3 `publication_disposition` + 1 repair claim (+1 re-bound
  `claim_evidence`) + 4 receipts + 1 apply-owned `ingest_run` — all
  append-only; `inventory_delta` reconciles exactly.
- Rematerialize: six steps in order; +3 coverage rows; +0 elsewhere.
- Frozen snapshot `sha256:138714a684982c982610ece27a8215fc93e0c4cc4a220b7574307ad358695d99`,
  `frozen_unpublished`; **13/16** claims eligible post-recovery.
- `PROVISIONAL_VS_SHADOW`: provisional rules active, shadow `applied: []`,
  four named activation refusals recorded.
